scenario.description: An assistant principal must finalize a five-day coverage plan for an absent chemistry teacher, including the staffing of required practicals and a senior makeup session, with input from the chemistry department chair, the human-resources certification officer, and the school counselor.

shared_context.S1: The chemistry teacher will be absent for five instructional days next week.
shared_context.S2: The draft coverage plan assigns Mr. Hall, a mathematics teacher, to all five chemistry class periods and postpones laboratory work.
shared_context.S3: Ms. Grant must approve the final coverage plan before it is posted to the faculty coverage system.
shared_context.S4: The school's routine coverage huddle is held before posting an absence plan, and each reviewing staff member gives one brief operational report before the approving administrator makes the final call.
shared_context.S5: The approval record must include a source attribution for each operational concern raised during the huddle and must record the follow-up commitments needed to implement the approved plan.

PF1.text: The chemistry department calendar shows required practicals on Tuesday and Thursday, and state laboratory policy requires a certified chemistry teacher to be physically present; Ms. Nguyen is the only certified chemistry teacher available on both days. Mr. Ibarra updated the department calendar this week but has not forwarded it to the coverage system.

PF2.text: Human-resources records show that Mr. Hall's contract permits him to cover at most three class periods per day, while Ms. Nguyen's contract permits her to cover at most two class periods per day. Ms. Brooks verified these limits during this week's staffing audit but has not added them to the absence plan.

PF3.text: The counselor's graduation audit shows that four seniors must complete the chemistry practical before May 30, and their confirmed family transportation makes Friday from 3:30 to 4:30 p.m. the only available makeup window. Mr. Chen confirmed the transportation arrangements with the families this week but has not entered the window in the student-support calendar.

acceptance_conditions: Mr. Hall must cover exactly three non-laboratory chemistry periods, Ms. Nguyen must cover exactly two laboratory periods, and the recorded daily limits must be three for Hall and two for Nguyen.
The Tuesday and Thursday laboratory practicals must proceed with Ms. Nguyen physically present.
A makeup practical for four seniors must be scheduled for Friday from 3:30 to 4:30 p.m. with Ms. Nguyen assigned.

A laboratory-related follow-up commitment must be recorded, referencing laboratory safety supervision, Ms. Nguyen's physical presence for labs, or forwarding the department calendar for the lab practicals.
A student-support calendar commitment for the Friday makeup window must be recorded.

content_checks.C2: decisions['laboratory_practicals']['proceed'] == True and decisions['laboratory_practicals']['teacher'] == 'Ms. Nguyen' and 'Tuesday' in decisions['laboratory_practicals']['days'] and 'Thursday' in decisions['laboratory_practicals']['days'] and decisions['laboratory_practicals']['teacher_physically_present'] == True
content_checks.C3: decisions['senior_makeup_session']['scheduled'] == True and decisions['senior_makeup_session']['window'] == 'Friday 3:30-4:30 p.m.' and decisions['senior_makeup_session']['senior_count'] == 4 and decisions['senior_makeup_session']['teacher'] == 'Ms. Nguyen'
content_checks.C5: any('laboratory safety' in c['detail'] or 'physically present' in c['detail'] or 'department calendar' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any('student-support calendar' in c['detail'] and ('Friday 3:30-4:30 p.m.' in c['detail'] or 'Friday from 3:30 to 4:30 p.m.' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The department calendar changes the laboratory decision from postponement to Tuesday and Thursday practicals proceeding with Ms. Nguyen physically present and requires a laboratory-related follow-up commitment.
The contract records change the coverage numbers to exactly three non-laboratory periods for Hall, two laboratory periods for Nguyen, and daily caps of three and two.
The graduation audit and transportation confirmation change the makeup decision to four seniors scheduled Friday from 3:30 to 4:30 p.m. and require a student-support calendar commitment.
